2024_182_mar_2024_pcard_report.paragraph: Monthly purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction listing for the Troy School District covering March 2024, printed 5/15/2024 and carried on the Board of Education agenda for the meeting of May 21, 2024. Every line records a transaction description with its date, the journal-entry description "MAR 2024 PCARD EXP", a budget unit, an account code, a transaction amount and a credits column, running across pages numbered 1 through 39 and covering charges posted from 2/27/2024 through 3/25/2024. The report closes with a Subtotal of 379,298.31 in transaction amounts against 6,739.12 in credits, and a printed "Total Expens" line of 372,559.19.
